Our Philosophy

A space
that supports the work

The space is primarily designed for body psychotherapy, and then for other modalities that use props in their work.

DEVA Hub rooms are fully equipped, comfortable, and filled with natural light, intended for individual work and work with smaller groups.

The Spaces

Rooms designed for
the body's work

Sound-Insulated Walls

Tara Room

A deeply quiet therapy room designed for one-on-one somatic sessions. Fabric-paneled walls absorb sound, creating an acoustic cocoon.

Natural Oak Flooring

Durga Room

Generous open floor space for movement-based practices — dance therapy, authentic movement, Feldenkrais, and breathwork groups.

Community & Kitchen

The Commons

A shared lounge for practitioners to gather, collaborate, and recharge between sessions. Natural light, books, and good coffee.

Terms of Use

Welcome to the DEVA Hub website, a therapy space operated by Centar DEVA. By using this website and booking a space, you accept the following terms of use.

1. Purpose of the space

DEVA Hub is a space intended for psychotherapeutic, counseling, educational, and other professional work in the field of mental health and personal development. The space may be used for: - individual therapy sessions, - work with couples and families, - small therapy and educational groups, - supervision, - workshops and professional meetings. Users are obliged to use the space in accordance with its purpose and with respect for other tenants.

2. Reservations

Reservations are made through the website or by arrangement with the centar DEVA team. A reservation is confirmed only after the availability of the time slot is confirmed. Permanent tenants have priority when booking their contracted time slots.

3. Payment

Individual sessions and monthly rentals are paid according to the current price list. Monthly rental implies booking the same time slot once a week during the month.

4. Cancellation

An individual session can be cancelled no later than 24 hours in advance. In case of later cancellation or no-show, the booking is considered used, unless otherwise agreed.

5. Use of the space

The user is responsible for: - respecting the reserved time, - leaving the space tidy, - careful use of furniture and equipment, - preserving the privacy of other users. It is not allowed to: - smoke in the space (except in a specially designated area), - bring in hazardous materials, - engage in activities that disturb the work of other tenants.

6. Liability

Centar DEVA is not responsible for personal belongings left in the space. The user is liable for any damage caused by intentional or careless use of the space or equipment.

7. Privacy

Centar DEVA respects the privacy of its users. Personal data is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy published on the website.

8. Changes to the terms

Centar DEVA reserves the right to change these terms of use at any time. All changes will be published on this page and take effect on the date of publication.

9. Contact

For any questions regarding reservations or use of the space, you can contact us via: E-mail: hello@centardeva.com Phone: +381641403475

Privacy Policy

Centar DEVA, operator of DEVA Hub, respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

1. Data we collect

We collect the following types of personal data: - Contact information: name, email address, and phone number provided when making a reservation or inquiry. - Booking information: reserved dates, times, and selected spaces. - Communication records: correspondence via email or phone. We do not collect sensitive data related to the therapeutic work conducted in the space.

2. Purpose of data processing

Your personal data is used exclusively for: - confirming and managing reservations, - communication regarding bookings and use of the space, - billing and payment processing, - informing you about important changes to our services. Your data will not be used for marketing purposes without your explicit consent.

3. Legal basis

We process your personal data on the basis of: - the performance of a contract (reservation and use of the space), - our legitimate interest in managing the business, - your consent where applicable. You may withdraw your consent at any time.

4. Data sharing

Centar DEVA does not sell or rent your personal data. Your data may be shared with third parties only when necessary for: - processing payments, - fulfilling legal obligations, - protecting our legal rights. All third parties are obligated to protect your data in accordance with applicable law.

5. Data retention

Your personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including legal, accounting, and tax requirements. After this period, the data is securely deleted or anonymized.

6. Data security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. Access to personal data is limited to authorized personnel only.

7. Your rights

You have the right to: - access your personal data, - request correction of inaccurate data, - request deletion of your data, - withdraw consent at any time, - file a complaint with the competent authority. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details below.

8. Cookies

Our website may use basic cookies to ensure proper functionality. We do not use cookies for tracking or advertising purposes.

9. Changes to this policy

Centar DEVA reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. All changes will be published on this page and take effect on the date of publication.

10. Contact

For any questions regarding your personal data or this Privacy Policy, you can contact us via: E-mail: hello@centardeva.com Phone: +381641403475
